name: 增氧机开启时长计算器

map.根据水体量、溶氧缺口与增氧机增氧能力，计算需开启时长: Compute the required runtime from the water volume, the DO deficit and the oxygenation capacity of the aerator.
map.水体体积=面积×666.67×水深(m³)；增氧机增氧速率(mg/L·h)=功率: Water volume = area × 666.67 × depth (m³); aerator oxygenation rate (mg/L·h) = power × SAE × 1000 ÷ volume; net oxygenation = oxygenation rate - consumption rate; required runtime = (target DO - current DO) ÷ net oxygenation. The SAE of a paddlewheel aerator is typically 1.2-2.0. Aeration cannot exceed saturation; this page uses 7.5 mg/L (from the ~7.6 mg/L saturation at warm water near 30℃) as a conservative cap.
map.需开启时长 = 溶氧缺口 ÷ 净增氧速率；缺口 = 目标溶氧 − 当前溶氧（mg: Runtime = DO deficit ÷ net oxygenation rate; deficit = target DO − current DO (mg/L); net oxygenation = power × efficiency × 1000 ÷ volume − natural consumption (mg/L·h); volume = area × 666.67 × depth (m³). Validation: area, depth, target DO, power and efficiency must be >0; current DO and consumption rate must be ≥0; invalid inputs clear the result with a prompt. Aeration cannot exceed saturation; without a water-temperature input, this page uses 7.5 mg/L (from the ~7.6 mg/L saturation at warm water near 30℃) as a conservative cap and prompts for water exchange / cooling / chemical oxygenation above it. Criteria: deficit ≤0 means no aeration needed; net oxygenation ≤0 means insufficient capacity, add power; runtime >6 h is long, add power or start earlier.
map.请检查输入：面积、水深、目标溶氧、功率、增氧效率须 >0；当前溶氧、耗氧率须 ≥: Please check the inputs: area, depth, target DO, power and efficiency must be >0; current DO and consumption rate must be ≥0.
map.超过曝气可达的饱和上限（本页按暖水 7.5 mg/L 保守估算）。曝气只能接近: exceeds the aeration saturation cap (this page conservatively assumes 7.5 mg/L for warm water). Aeration can only approach saturation, never exceed it; exchange water, cool the water or use chemical oxygenation. To use the saturation value for a specific temperature, consult the DO saturation table for that temperature.
map.已知水体体积与溶氧缺口，按增氧机净增氧速率估算需开启时长，避免盲目长开或开不足。: Given the water volume and the DO deficit, estimate the required runtime from the net oxygenation rate of the aerator, avoiding blind long running or under-running.
map.换水/施药后溶氧骤降时快速决策补氧时长。: Make a quick decision on the supplementary oxygenation time when DO drops sharply after water exchange or medication.
map.多台机组并联时按总净增氧速率折算。: Convert by the total net oxygenation rate when several units run in parallel.
map.4000 m³ 水体、溶氧从 3 升至 5 mg/L、净增氧 0.825 mg/: 4000 m³ of water, DO raised from 3 to 5 mg/L, net oxygenation 0.825 mg/L·h
map.默认参数：溶氧缺口 = 5−3 = 2.00 mg/L；水体 4000 m³，需: Default parameters: DO deficit = 5−3 = 2.00 mg/L; for 4000 m³ the concentration deficit to be made up is 2.00 mg/L; at a net oxygenation rate of 0.825 mg/L·h the estimated runtime is ≈ 2.42 hours (deficit / net rate).
map.净增氧速率怎么理解？: How should the net oxygenation rate be understood?
map.是增氧机产氧减去水体自然耗氧后的有效速率，实际受水温、气压与机况影响。: It is the effective rate after subtracting the natural oxygen consumption of the water from the oxygen output of the aerator, and is affected in practice by water temperature, air pressure and machine condition.
map.开启时长算出来很短/很长？: The computed runtime comes out very short/long?
map.过短说明缺口小或机力强，过长说明缺氧严重需多机并联或先换水。: Too short means the deficit is small or the machine is powerful; too long means severe hypoxia, calling for several units in parallel or a water exchange first.
